terms: Pilot Edition: Pinoy Pages 2026–2027 (Category: Money & Business, Greater Toronto Area). The printed proof copy is released spring (April 16, 2027); the website is updated year-round.

Listings are Free, or Verified at $199 per issue (one quarterly season, CAD, shown before tax; no HST is charged), as an identity badge only (no QR or ZCard). Loyalty rate: after 4 seasons at $199, it's $99.50 per issue for the next 4 seasons. No add-ons, bundles or founding discounts in the pilot. Print ads are now booking for the 2026–2027 edition; rates on request.

Verified Kabayan badge: payment never buys the badge. The badge certifies identity only (owner identity + business licence or registration). Verified listings are only eligible; the badge is earned on a ~15-minute live video check (owner on camera, ID viewed and never stored, business licence or registration checked, a live premises walkthrough or screen-share, one proof of trading, and your ZCard completed on the call). ID is viewed, never stored. Verification is online only. We may withhold the badge if a check fails; the Verified listing continues without it.
Free listings are unverified: name and contact only, with no badge. QR codes and ZCards are advertiser products, not part of Verified.
Keeping your badge — renewal by issue: the badge stays while your Verified listing is renewed each issue. A light re-check at renewal updates the “Verified [date]”.
Keeping your badge — current details: contact details and the ZCard must stay current. A dead phone number or a closed business pauses the badge.
Keeping your badge — renewal: if you don't renew, the badge is removed and the listing drops to a Free listing.
Keeping your badge — complaints: a complaint pauses the badge pending review. Paused badges are not shown.
QR codes always resolve through pinoypages.ca. Our pages never ask for a login, a payment or personal information.
Website mirror: your online presence mirrors your print presence and is included free in every tier.
No guarantee of results: we report scan counts monthly (Verified). We do not promise any number of leads, calls, sales or visitors.

Printed edition: a short-run proof copy for advertisers (one copy per paid advertiser) and a sales brochure for prospects. It is not sold or handed out to the public. If it does not print, print ad fees are refunded.
Prices are in CAD and shown before tax. No HST is charged. Draft terms, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
